summary: Recent updates to Firefox's media control system have enhanced how the browser manages audio sessions, particularly during interruptions like notifications or emerging calls. Key improvements include the tracking of audio-session interruption states, which helps coordinate when to pause playback, and introducing controls to mute audio more seamlessly. This means that when an interruption occurs, audio playback can now be paused effectively and resumed afterward, ensuring a smoother listening experience for users. **These changes matter because they make audio playback more user-friendly and responsive, especially in busy environments where interruptions are common.**
